theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_im_median_minimizes
theorems.statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) (F : Set α) (a c₀ : ℝ) (u : α → ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 < a → μ F = ENNReal.ofReal a → Measurable u → IntegrableOn u F μ → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | u x ≤ c₀}) → ENNReal.ofReal (a / 2) ≤ μ (F ∩ {x | c₀ ≤ u x}) → ∀ c : ℝ, ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - c₀| ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ x in F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - c| ∂μ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
